item.title: Iran Launches Missile Attack on Tel Aviv in Retaliation for Latest Killings
item.summary: Iranian state media confirmed the killings of Ali Larijani, who had served as Iran’s de facto leader recently, and a militia commander late Tuesday. Airstrikes rocked the Lebanese capital early Wednesday.

item.title: Dozens Dead in Pakistani Airstrike on Kabul
item.summary: The attack hit a drug rehabilitation facility, and Afghanistan vowed to retaliate, risking an escalation of the conflict between the two countries.

item.title: At Least 23 Killed in Nigeria as Insurgent Attacks Go On Despite U.S. Help
item.summary: A teaching hospital and two markets in the city of Maiduguri were hit in what a military spokesman said were suicide bombings by Boko Haram.

item.title: Trump Signals He May Intervene in Cuba Following Iran and Venezuela
item.summary: Still at war with Iran and in control in Venezuela, President Trump is signaling that he is about to intervene in another country.

item.title: Sucked Into War, Gulf Countries Face the Limits of U.S. Security Guarantees
item.summary: Barraged by Iranian attacks and questioning the value of security ties with the United States, nations in the Gulf have turned to Ukraine, Australia and Italy for help.

item.title: What the Iran War Means for the U.S.-China Relationship
item.summary: With the Xi-Trump summit almost certainly delayed, and tensions rising over the war in Iran, vital issues for both the U.S. and China are also being cast into uncertainty.

item.title: As Iran War Drags On, Europe Wants to Avoid a New Migration Crisis
item.summary: A decade ago, a surge in migration to Europe spurred the far-right’s rise. European leaders now fear the Iran war could set off another crisis, and they have taken tentative steps to prepare.

item.title: Inside the Supply Line Delivering American Guns to Mexican Cartels
item.summary: A surge of weapons is flowing from the U.S. to Mexico. These firearms — sourced from gun shops, shows, websites and apps — are funneled across the border to fuel the country’s most violent crimes.

item.title: As American Bombers Take Off From R.A.F. Fairford in UK, Iraq War Looms Large
item.summary: R.A.F. Fairford was the site of repeated antiwar protests during the Iraq war in 2003. Now it is being used again as a base for U.S. bombing missions in the Middle East.

item.title: What to Know About Ali Larijani, Iran’s Top Security Official
item.summary: One of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s closest confidants, Mr. Larijani emerged as the face of the government after Mr. Khamenei was killed.
